summary: Phase 6 Multi Label Merge Wizard + Phase 5 public request + admin batch view + Multi Label dashboard — ALL PASS (10/10 backend, 4/4 UI flows). Backend: merge validate/commit with 3 MGQA labels aggregates Rp9.000.000 (legacy Rp9.999.999 excluded), idempotent=true on re-commit, old accounts mgqa-b/c blocked login (403 'akun digabungkan'), primary mgqa-a still logs in, validate rejects already-merged label with ok:false errors, Admin Finance (finance1) gets 403 on commit (labels.multi_label.manage). Public /multi-label/request works unauth, admin sees it, GET /admin/multi-label/requests OK. GET /withdraw/admin/batches → 200. UI: /ajukan-multi-label form → success screen; /admin/multi-label wizard 5 steps → commit → account card visible with 3 labels + Bank Central Asia + Rp9.000.000; admin-ml-batch-panel present on /admin/withdraw; /label/dashboard shows Rp5.000.000, label-global-switcher, Active Label switcher, Analytics filter. critical_code_review_comments: multi_label_merge.py _validate() correctly gates payout_bank_account_id ownership to selected labels, blocks re-use of a label already owned by a different multi_label account, and blocks concurrent merges via active merge doc check — solid.

commit() is atomic-ish: writes a 'committing' merge doc and marks 'completed' at the end; on exception marks 'failed'. There is no MongoDB transaction wrapping label reassignment / user status flip / bank creation — if the process dies mid-way the recovery is manual (as noted in the HTTPException detail). Acceptable trade-off for MVP but flag for future.

Idempotency only returns idempotent=true when the merge doc is completed AND all label owners match; a re-commit before the first completed doc is created will re-run. In practice fine because commit is synchronous.
auth.py correctly returns 403 with Indonesian 'akun digabungkan' text when user.status == 'merged' — validated end-to-end.

Accounts endpoint returns aggregate_balance_idr (matches spec's Rp9.000.000), but the review-request wording said 'aggregate' — no mismatch, just a naming note. The 'last_withdrawn_period' invariant per-label is NOT surfaced on the /accounts response (only on preview from /validate). If admins need to see per-label cutoffs in the Akun Multi Label tab, add it to the labels array in /admin/multi-label/accounts.
